name: led_color_cal.get_matrix
purpose: Read all nine current LED color-correction coefficients for the selected configured side.
control_flow_proof: Physical59 resolves output object2083E248 toA0567ABC, vtableA0567AC0, slot8 targetA024E56E. Physical60 reads live index-count2083E244 as2. Exact index0/1 passes both target guards, so all18output bytes are initialized. Target chooses cached normal matrix20AB00B4+18*index or override20AB00FC+18*index based on cached flag20AB00A0[index], and copies18bytes to caller stack. Handler prints nine signed halfwords. No setter, light, calibration or motor operation.
side_effects: Local stack output buffer, UART output and parser state only.
interpretation: Current cached coefficients; this query does not run or validate physical calibration. Side labels follow firmware index conventions.
